context: A terse request to de-AI a changelog entry: the 2.4.0 entry loses its promotional voice while every fact and the older entry survive.

checklist.name: Facts kept
checklist.description: The 2.4.0 entry still states: reads pause when the outbound queue passes 80% of queue.max instead of dropping batches; zstd is the default codec with roughly 35% less bandwidth than gzip; --legacy-ack is removed (deprecated in 2.1.0) and marked breaking; the date 2026-09-28.

checklist.name: Promotion cut
checklist.description: The thrilled/game-changing/next-level opener, the fast-paced-world paragraph, the 'In Conclusion' section, the emoji, and words like seamless, robust, empowers, blazing-fast are gone, not rephrased into new filler.

checklist.name: Breaking change prominent
checklist.description: The --legacy-ack removal is easy to spot as breaking (labeled breaking or in its own breaking section), not buried in prose.

checklist.name: Rest untouched
checklist.description: The 2.3.1 entry and the file's heading structure are unchanged; nothing outside the 2.4.0 entry is rewritten.

checklist.name: No invented content
checklist.description: No new claims, numbers, migration steps, or features appear that the original entry did not state.
